title: Semantics of First-Order Logic
summary: Defines S-assignments, the value of a term, the truth value of a FOL formula, and the notions of satisfiability, validity, equivalence, and semantical consequence in FOL.
learning_outcomes: Evaluate the value of a term under an assignment.
Inductively evaluate the truth value of a FOL formula.
Determine satisfiability and validity of FOL formulae.
